mines.mine_notes: FY2025: 176,341 oz poured (sulphide 135,436 oz @ AISC $1,956/oz; oxide 40,905 oz @ $2,181/oz), 18% lower than 2024 due to lower head grades and explosive supply disruption in H2. Gold sold 160,685 oz. Processed 3.93 Mt @ 1.74 g/t, 78.4% recovery (sulphide plant 2.36 Mt @ 2.25 g/t, 76.5% recovery; oxide plant 1.57 Mt @ 0.98 g/t, 81.6% recovery). Sulphide Conversion Project (SSCP) under construction: increases sulphide capacity 60% from 2.4 to 4.0 Mtpa; stage 1 commissioning Q2 2026. Underground sub-level cave + oxide open pits. Government of Mali holds 20%.
mines.processing: Sulphide plant (roaster/CCIL) + oxide plant; combined ~3.9 Mtpa

mines.mine_notes: FY2025: 100,895 oz poured at AISC $1,269/oz (2024: 123.9 koz @ $1,244/oz). Open pit mining ended June 2025; transitioned to stockpile processing in H2 2025 and into 2026. Ore mined 1.8 Mt (2024: 3.1 Mt); processed 2.28 Mt @ 1.49 g/t, 91.7% recovery. Gold sold 97,859 oz. Owned via 90% of Petowal Mining Company S.A. (Government of Senegal 10%). Mako Life Extension Project (MLEP): satellite deposits Tomboronkoto (reserves 348 koz) and Bantaco (MRE 365 koz) within trucking distance. Capex 2025: $2.9M.
mines.status: Operating (stockpile processing since July 2025; open pit mining ended June 2025)

mines.mine_notes: Acquired May 2025. DFS update (15 Dec 2025): ~170 koz average annual production over 13-year mine life; NPV5% $2.5 billion at $4,000/oz gold price. Construction expected to commence H1 2026 upon permits and FID; early works and long-lead procurement ongoing; first gold pour targeted H1 2028. Key plank of strategy to exceed 500 kozpa by end-2028. Ore Reserve 59.1 Mt @ 1.3 g/t = 2,497 koz (Proved 1.4 Mt @ 1.6 g/t = 73 koz; Probable 57.7 Mt @ 1.3 g/t = 2,424 koz), group share 90% = 2,247 koz. MRE 114.2 Mt @ 1.2 g/t = 4,359 koz.
mines.status: Development (DFS complete; construction targeted H1 2026, first gold H1 2028)

mines.mine_notes: Acquired May 2025. Exploration-stage; Inferred MRE 72.0 Mt @ 0.9 g/t = 2,160 koz (within 250m of surface, 0.5 g/t cut-off). La Debo prospect: Inferred 17.6 Mt @ 1.1 g/t = 643 koz.

notes: FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025), 2025 Annual Report. Group: 277,236 oz poured (Syama 176,341 oz, Mako 100,895 oz), within guidance; 258,544 oz sold at average realised price $3,338/oz; group AISC $1,843/oz (2024: $1,476/oz); revenue $865.6M; EBITDA $397.7M; net profit after tax $149.4M (2024: -$26.0M); operating cash flow $226.4M; net cash $209.1M (cash + term deposits $130.7M + bullion, less $57.8M borrowings); available liquidity $322.3M. Capex $117.5M (incl. Syama Sulphide Conversion Project, Doropo and ABC acquired May 2025). 2026 guidance: group 250-275 koz @ AISC $2,000-$2,200/oz; capex $310-$360M. All figures in USD. Resolute holds 80% of Syama (Mali), 90% in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire assets; reserves/resources stated at 100% with group-share column in the AR. Mansala (Guinea, 100%): Inferred 6.6 Mt @ 1.6 g/t = 343 koz, not included as a mine.
